scope: One continuous six-direction20s-per-stage GUI simulation with final30s stance, plus a separate8s forward visual replay. No control-source or parameter tuning in this task.

merged_truth_and_fk_csv.overlap_policy: kinematics-full.csv wins equal rounded-nanosecond sim_time_s; all distinct simulated times retained
merged_truth_and_fk_csv.time_semantics: merged_elapsed_sim_s spans both recorders; each original elapsed_sim_s is recorder-local and not used for metrics

findings: All six20s motions and named stops plus30s final stance completed in the same simulation.
This continuous trial is a strict overall tracking FAIL: forward initial-heading off-axis displacement0.281999m exceeds unchanged0.25m bound. Previous C04 successes do not override it.

Forward world lateral displacement is0.015385m and changing-heading lateral integral is-0.005175m; a transient initial yaw of-0.027484rad explains much of the initial-heading projection. This does not change the acceptance result.
Backward full-motion mean height0.329031m is about10.97mm below the0.34m nominal target.
Peak geometric foot clearance is approximately0.0624–0.0732m in this trial, below the nominal0.10m swing setting; geometry is reconstructed, not measured contact.
Original long passive preview is retained in merged CSV and excluded from all motion metrics by finalized phase timestamps.

The supervision-wrapper143 exit is retained in interruption metadata; separately owned physics/test process groups completed without a new physics instance. Acceptance relies on finalized sweep and continuous telemetry.
limitations: The long PASSIVE preview is retained in merged CSV but every motion metric uses the finalized sweep phase timestamps only.
Body velocity is inverse full truth orientation applied to centred finite differences of distinct 100Hz truth poses. Last2s script metrics use truth twist and remain separate.
Full-motion statistics include acceleration and transient settling; last2s statistics do not replace whole-phase drift.
World, initial-heading and changing-heading displacements are different coordinates and separately labelled.
No truth is fed back to the controller. Planned contact confidence is not measured foot force.
No torque warning is not proof of calibrated hardware current/torque compliance. Only simulation was exercised.

primary_orchestration_interruption.cause: SIGTERM received by original orchestration process; cause not established. Simulator and test were separate process groups and continued.

initial_recording_limitation.reason: Initial recording used a buffered rotating diagnostics file. Subsequent recording subscribes directly to live ROS /clock and retains variable GIF frame timing.

limitations: Primary continuous trial remains an overall strict tracking failure. A passed short visual replay does not replace that result.
Foot clearance is geometry reconstructed from simulated truth body pose and joint feedback; it is not measured foot contact or hardware force.
Backward height remains about11mm below nominal, and actual geometric swing peaks remain around6.2–7.3cm versus the configured10cm.
Short desktop simulation does not establish hardware locomotion or onboard real-time deadline acceptance. No physical robot was commanded.
